items.text: Kansas City (final report): OUT: DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee). QUESTIONABLE: CB L'Jarius Sneed (knee), CB Mansoor Delane (shoulder, no practice), DE R. Mason Thomas (personal). WR Rashee Rice is off the report and returns; Patrick Mahomes (knee) was full with no designation.

Denver (final report): OUT: RB RJ Harvey (knee), S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle). QUESTIONABLE: WR Jaylen Waddle (chest), DL Zach Allen (hamstring), LT Garett Bolles (hip), S Brandon Jones (hamstring). Pat Surtain II was full.
